statement: A combination of four cell cycle regulators drove adult mouse cardiomyocytes to divide and improved cardiac function after myocardial infarction.

context.intervention: combined CDK1, CDK4, cyclin B1 and cyclin D1 expression

measurement.effect: efficient division of post-mitotic cardiomyocytes; improved function

limitations: four-factor delivery has no clinical vehicle
